purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system used in Japanese medical billing. It handles system management information settings for a medical institution (specifically disaster/casualty medical facility information, W13 screen). It manages screen state, table data for medical fee classifications, tax categories, equipment codes, and damage classification lists.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims processing)

verdict.notes: The file is encoded in latin-1 but contains Japanese text (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) that appears as mojibake. The source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~110KB total. The program is part of the well-known open-source ORCA medical receipt software project maintained by the Japan Medical Association. The COPY statements reference many external copybooks that are not shown. The W01.INC–W30.INC etc. includes suggest a screen-based subprogram driven by an MCP (screen/widget) framework typical of ORCA's GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL architecture.
